# Miauterm 0.1.2-coral

This release uses Coral as its codename.

- Reduce vertical spacing in Settings rows while keeping the dark, flat interface.
- Keep confirmation text white for readability on orange actions.
- Label default terminal tabs `session 0` through `session 7`, with a maximum of eight open sessions.
- Use Miauterm's app logo for launcher long-press shortcuts.
- Fix launcher long-press actions by explicitly targeting the installed Miauterm package.
- Make the extra-key `SHIFT` button toggle like `CTRL` and `ALT`, so it modifies the next terminal key instead of sending a standalone key event.
- Give dialog actions clear contrast with flat neutral and orange button surfaces.
- Open the Miauterm GitHub issue form directly from Settings > Updates & Support.
- Fix Android lint annotation imports so the app compiles in GitHub Actions.

The release includes signed ARM64 APKs and SHA-256 checksums. Install on Android 7.0 or newer with an ARM64 processor.
